data.name: Aurelia application compatibility certification

introduced.event_name: COMDEX 1979 — Aurelia+ and compatibility kit launch

includes: Eight engineering hours for review and application acceptance testing
Versioned configuration report and optional designation on passing
Failures returned for correction; additional work and incremental retests quoted separately
Relevant hardware, OS or adapter changes require scoped retesting; manufacturer supports its own machines
data.commercial_policy: Optional standard agreement; implementation is not conditional on purchase. AION-funded ports, proprietary source access and OEM application redistribution require separate agreements.
